skill.name: gpt-image-2
skill.description: Generate or edit images with GPT Image 2 through the RunComfy CLI. The skill covers supported sizes, reference images, prompt design, polling, and output downloads.
skill.summary: Create precise GPT Image 2 generations and edits through RunComfy.
skill.author: prime-skills

security_audit.summary: All 53 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, visible documentation URLs, prose ellipses, and documented CLI behavior. Semantic review found shell injection risk in prompt examples, unpinned global installers, and expected third-party prompt and image processing.

remediation.issue: User prompts are interpolated into single-quoted shell JSON.
remediation.suggestion: Pass arguments without a shell, or build input with a structured JSON tool. Never concatenate prompt text into a command string.

remediation.issue: Installation commands use mutable package and repository references.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the CLI package version and skill repository commit. Avoid global installation when a project-local installation is sufficient.

remediation.issue: Prompts and reference image URLs are processed by RunComfy.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before upload. Warn users not to submit secrets, private images, or expiring URLs without reviewing service policies.

content.user_title: Create and Edit Images with GPT Image 2
content.value_statement: Precise image generation and editing often requires model-specific inputs and prompt structure. This skill guides GPT Image 2 jobs through the RunComfy CLI.
actual_capabilities: Submits text-to-image requests to the GPT Image 2 RunComfy endpoint.
Edits one primary image with guidance from up to ten public image URLs.
Selects square, portrait, or landscape output sizes for generation.
Uses automatic aspect-ratio preservation for image edits.
Guides prompts for embedded text, multilingual signs, layouts, and preserved elements.
Polls asynchronous jobs and downloads approved RunComfy output URLs.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and network access.
Text-to-image supports only three fixed output sizes.
Reference images must use publicly fetchable HTTPS URLs, with ten images maximum.
Prompts and reference URLs leave the local system for remote processing.

use_cases.title: Build Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Create product images with controlled lighting, readable labels, and consistent composition.

use_cases.title: Localize Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Replace short embedded text while preserving the source layout and brand elements.

use_cases.title: Create Labeled Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate interface mockups, posters, or technical illustrations with specific labels and layout cues.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [subject] in [setting]. Use [lighting], a [mood] mood, and a [square, portrait, or landscape] composition.

prompt_templates.title: Product Image with Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product image of [item]. The label reads "[short text]" in [script or language]. Use [lighting] and [background].
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a product visual with short embedded text.

prompt_templates.title: Preserving Image Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Change [target element] to [desired result]. Keep [identity, pose, framing, typography, or brand mark] unchanged. Preserve the original aspect ratio.
prompt_templates.scenario: Edit one image while protecting important details.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Reference Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the subject from image 1 and [lighting, setting, or style] from image 2. Preserve [constraints]. Place [elements] at [positions].
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine selected attributes from several reference images.

output_examples.input: Create a square studio image of a ceramic bottle labeled "AQUA+" on a neutral background.
output_examples.output: A downloaded square product image with soft studio lighting, a centered bottle, and the requested short label.

output_examples.input: Replace the room background with a bright studio while keeping the person's face, pose, and framing unchanged.
output_examples.output: An edited image that preserves the subject and composition while replacing the background.

output_examples.input: Combine the subject from the first reference with the lighting and room from the second reference.
output_examples.output: A generated composite using the first image as the primary subject and the second image as environmental guidance.

best_practices: State the subject, setting, lighting, mood, and composition with concrete terms.
Quote short embedded text exactly and name the required language or script.
Change one attribute per edit and list every element that must remain unchanged.
anti_patterns: Do not combine conflicting instructions such as requesting both no text and a visible headline.
Do not stack many unrelated styles in one prompt.
Do not place untrusted prompt text directly inside a shell command.

faq.question: Does this skill call OpenAI directly?
faq.answer: No. It uses the RunComfy CLI and RunComfy Model API to access GPT Image 2.

faq.question: Which output sizes are supported?
faq.answer: Generation supports 1024 by 1024, 1024 by 1536, and 1536 by 1024. Editing also supports automatic aspect-ratio preservation.

faq.question: Can it edit several reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The edit endpoint accepts up to ten public HTTPS image URLs. The first image is the primary reference.

faq.question: Can it render text inside an image?
faq.answer: Yes. Short quoted text works best. Name the language or script when generating multilingual text.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads approved output URLs into the selected output directory.

faq.question: What data leaves my computer?
faq.answer: The prompt and reference image URLs are sent to RunComfy. Review sensitive content before submitting a request.
